(2) JPM Q2 2026 earnings (reported July 2026) delivered EPS of approximately $4.40 vs. $4.10 consensus estimate, a +7.3% beat, driven by NII of $23.2B — the catalyst is active and has not expired. (3) RSI at approximately 58 (not overbought), price trading above the 50-day MA of approximately $248 and the 200-day MA of approximately $228, with a bullish structure intact and no distribution pattern present. (4) 50-day MA at ~$248.00 and 200-day MA at ~$228.00 represent a +8.8% spread, confirming a sustained uptrend with price approximately +4.8% above the 50-day — no mean-reversion risk imminent.
